description: This file defines a final class 'ImmutablePolicyBuilderLabelScoped' that implements a scoped builder pattern for creating 'Policy' objects associated with specific labels. It provides fluent API methods to configure various attributes of a policy, such as ID, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, subjects, resources, and permissions, scoped to labels. The class is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies' package and interacts with other classes like PolicyBuilder, Label, PolicyEntry, Subjects, Subject, Resources, Resource, ResourceKey, Permissions, and EffectedPermissions.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyBuilderLabelScoped
classes.description: A mutable, label-scoped builder for creating immutable Policy objects with a fluent API, ensuring thread safety is not guaranteed. It delegates configuration to an underlying 'PolicyBuilder' instance and scopes all modifications to a specific label.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new label-scoped PolicyBuilder with a specified delegate and label.

methods.name: forLabel
methods.description: Creates a new label-scoped builder for a different label.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with this builder.

methods.name: exitLabel
methods.description: Returns to the delegate PolicyBuilder, exiting the label scope.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the PolicyId for the policy being built.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle state of the policy.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision information for the policy.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last modification.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds a PolicyEntry to the policy.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple PolicyEntries to the policy.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a PolicyEntry identified by label.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific PolicyEntry.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes multiple PolicyEntries.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Associates Subjects with a specific label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Associates a single Subject with a label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a Subject association from a label.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Associates Resources with a label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Associates a single Resource with a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a Resource association from a label by resource key.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a Resource from a label.

methods.name: setPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets permissions for a label and resource key.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets granted permissions for a label and resource key.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets granted permissions with multiple permission strings.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets revoked permissions for a label and resource key.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets revoked permissions with multiple permission strings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the constructed Policy.
